headline: Gold Price in Pakistan Jumps to Rs390,136 Per Tola
summary: Gold prices in Pakistan surged on Friday, reaching Rs390,136 per tola after gaining Rs11,500 during the day, following gains in international markets.
why: Domestic gold pricing reflects international bullion trends combined with local currency devaluation and safe-haven demand.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Tracking global bullion increases drives up domestic retail and wholesale gold quotes.
